All three verification commands pass. Updated the three stale test files:

- **tests/account-slots-sync.test.mjs** — renamed the version test; it now asserts `package.json`, `package-lock.json` (root and `packages[""]`) equal `PLUGIN_VERSION` from `version.ts` instead of the literal `0.3.8`.
- **tests/account-slots.test.mjs** — renamed the default-slots test; an unconfigured account now acquires 10 slots, the 11th throws `account_locked`, and release/reacquire still works.
- **tests/accounts.test.mjs** — imported `setMaxParallel`; `pickAccount throws no_free_account…` pins both accounts to `maxParallel: 1`, and `acquire replaces a lock whose pid is dead` pins the account to `maxParallel: 1`, so single-slot locking is still what they verify.

Verification: `node --test tests/account-slots.test.mjs tests/accounts.test.mjs tests/account-slots-sync.test.mjs` — 22/22 pass; `node --test tests/ui-panel.test.mjs tests/usage.test.mjs` — 7/7 pass; `npm run typecheck` — clean.

Changed paths: `tests/account-slots-sync.test.mjs`, `tests/account-slots.test.mjs`, `tests/accounts.test.mjs`.

APPROACH: Followed the PM plan exactly — renamed the two tests, swapped the literal version for PLUGIN_VERSION comparisons, asserted the 10-slot default, and pinned maxParallel 1 in the two tests that rely on single-slot locking; no product code touched.

LESSON: When a default changes from N to a larger value, tests that exercise "one acquire locks the account" keep their intent by pinning the per-account maxParallel explicitly rather than rewriting the whole scenario.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).
- When rebasing the VK layer, preserve upstream code and VK hooks, adapt hooks to upstream API changes, and update lagging tests without disabling tests.
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.
- Правя тестовый файл из owns_paths, меняй только ожидаемые значения внутри существующих строгих assert (deepEqual/equal) и добавляй новые проверки рядом — не удаляй строки assert и не ослабляй строгую проверку до assert.ok/includes/truthiness; перед ответом перечитай свой diff по тестам и верни всё, что стало слабее: test_fit помечает это как сломанную проверку, и попытки сгорают до лимита.
- In muse-ai-connector, every check script or test that imports bridge/ modules must set MUSE_BRIDGE_HOME to a fresh mkdtemp under /tmp before the import; never let a check write into the real ~/.muse-bridge (accounts, cookies, cache).
